jobs.title: Senior Product Manager II, Consumer (all genders)
jobs.description: The role HelloFresh serves millions of customers weekly across 18 business units and 8 brands worldwide. At the heart of our product is a belief that every customer deserves a menu that feels like it was made for them, the right meals, at the right time, for the right person. We call it the Sous Chef vision. As Senior PM II on the Personalization Experience team , you own what makes that vision real and  felt . You re not building the ranking algorithm, you re building the experiences that make customers trust it, the data collection that makes it smart, and the moments where someone thinks: this app actually knows me . This is a high-autonomy role at the intersection of consumer UX, engineering, and ML systems. The problems are genuinely hard, the scale is real, and the decisions are yours to make. What you’ll do Food Profile Quality & Signal Collection: The food profile is the raw material that powers everything downstream. Your job is to move customers from "fields filled in" to truly Personalization-Ready: high-signal, validated, actionable. You ll own and iterate on the collection experiences that give our models the data they need to perform. The "Sous Chef" Feel & Transparency: You build the moments where personalization becomes tangible, the places where we tell customers why certain meals were chosen for them. This isn t just UX work, it s trust infrastructure for the entire personalization stack. Cross-Org Data Supplier : You re the clean, reliable interface between raw signal and downstream experience, owning the explanation payloads and API contracts that make it all work at scale. You operate across organizational boundaries and align on shared metrics without needing to own the surfaces. AI-Native Discovery You use GenAI tools actively to compress discovery-to-decision cycles, synthesizing global customer signals, stress-testing hypotheses, and arriving at decision-ready specs faster than traditional PM workflows allow.

jobs.description: About the role At HelloFresh, data is at the heart of everything we do — from the moment a customer places an order to the way we forecast demand, optimize our supply chain, and personalize experiences for millions of people. Making that data fast, reliable, and available is what our Data Platform makes possible. We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join our Operational Data Platform team — the squad that ensures operational data is created, delivered, and shared downstream reliably, cost-efficiently, and with the quality guarantees that everything downstream depends on — so the analytics layer receives quality data, ready to be turned into governed assets. You will build the streaming, messaging, and self-service provisioning systems that hundreds of backend and data engineers rely on every day. This is a hands-on engineering role at the core of our platform. You ll own critical infrastructure, drive efficiency, and help define the "golden path" that makes it effortless for engineers across the company to store and stream their data — with governance and cost control built in from the start. What you ll do Build and run our streaming and messaging platform. Own the systems that move data in real time and at scale — Kafka, Kafka Connect, Flink, and SQS — and keep them fast, resilient, and easy to build on. Drive efficiency. Identify and act on opportunities to reduce the cost and complexity of the platform, and make efficiency a default rather than an afterthought. Own the reliability of critical data paths. Keep the systems at the heart of the platform highly available, and continuously improve their resilience, observability, and operational maturity. Enable self-service for operational data stores. Build and maintain the Terraform modules and tooling that let engineering teams use the right database for their use case within minutes, with governance and cost guardrails out of the box. jobs.description: What We Do: Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact. Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. You will own the strategy and operating model for our Automation and Agentic AI Center of Excellence, turning tools such as Claude, Glean, Zapier, and related platforms into practical systems that improve how teams get work done. You embrace continuous improvement by testing what has the most leverage, learning quickly, and improving the patterns that scale. You find friction before it becomes someone else’s problem and owning the path from idea to adoption. jobs.title: Engineering Manager - UK
jobs.description: Hi I’m Colin , Director of Engineering, Europe. How do you feel about software engineers writing product specs, making product decisions, and not breaking down projects into individual tickets? If that sounds exciting (even if a bit scary), read on because I’m looking for an engineering manager to help us build a different type of engineering team and culture at Ashby . To start, why do we need to be different? Time and again, I have witnessed engineers knowing what needs to be done yet being unable to get things done because of “the process” or because “more data is needed.” Some of the most effective projects have been skunkworks projects, where engineers have taken total ownership of a problem and driven it to completion. I want to normalize that at Ashby. When we think about how these processes came about, we realize they carry a pessimistic mindset. They box people into smaller roles to minimize the chance of not meeting a certain standard. At Ashby. we’re building an environment that is optimistic about what engineers can own and achieve and embraces the innovative engineers (and frankly, often stays out of their way). To accomplish this, our engineering leaders need to think deeply about individual performance, process, and culture - not running sprint planning or driving product and technical decisions. You’ll focus on building your team, their skills to thrive with the ownership they’re given, and an environment that empowers them to do their best work consistently, with little distraction. For junior EMs we try to stay within 6 direct reports. This enables them to spend time with our teams observing, correcting, praising, and, yes, coding. We like our managers to be hands-on while also making sure they’re not on the critical path. We’ve already gathered an experienced, talented, and collaborative team of 25+ engineers. jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description: About Enode The grid was built for predictable, centralised power. Today it's absorbing intermittent supply from grid scale solar and wind, alongside dynamic demand from EVs, heat pumps, and home batteries. The missing piece is software that can connect and orchestrate these devices at scale. Enode provides the infrastructure layer that makes this possible. Our Connect API gives energy companies a single integration to 1000+ devices across 80+ brands. Our optimisation tooling gives energy companies the building blocks to manage those devices locally - think smart charging for EVs. Our Flex product turns those connected devices into a flexible, controllable asset for energy companies. We work with device manufacturers across the energy hardware ecosystem - from EV brands to heat pump and solar inverter producers. Our customers are energy retailers, utilities, and traders building the next generation of energy services. We're backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital, and Creandum. The decisions made now will shape how the energy system gets built. We're looking for people who take ownership, move fast, and care deeply about the role technology can play in the energy transition. jobs.title: Account Executive - Germany 🇩🇪
jobs.description: Our Mission ⚖️ At Doctrine, we're building Europe's leading legal AI platform. Our belief? Law shouldn't be slowed down by repetitive tasks. It should be augmented by a specialised AI, designed to understand, analyse and produce legal reasoning at the highest standard. Our ambition? To help legal professionals work with greater reliability, efficiency and peace of mind, through a single, comprehensive and secure platform. Today, 27,000 legal professionals across five countries (France, Italy, Germany, Spain and Luxembourg) trust us to do just that. Our growth is guided by a clear approach: a global vision, grounded in a deep understanding of local specificities. Behind this ambition, a team of around 250 people, united around one goal: supporting lawyers and legal professionals at every stage of their work, from research to drafting. And we're just getting started. Doctrine employs over 280 people and has been growing steadily and profitably for several years. In 2025, we are entering a new phase, becoming multi-country and multi-product. After launching in our first international market, Italy, Doctrine is continuing its global expansion with Germany. We are therefore looking for several Account Executive to scale our commercial impact in the German market. A word about the Germany Team ✨ When you join, you’ll be onboarded and supported by your manager, Pascale (Head of New Business), who will help you ramp up and succeed in your role. You’ll work closely with our Account Executive on the German market (3 sales in Paris / 2 sales in Dusseldorf), collaborating on opportunities and helping drive our growth in Germany. You’ll also be supported by our broader German go-to-market team 🇩🇪, enabling you to move forward confidently in your conversations with prospects: Eloise (Product Manager), Maïte (Legal Counsel), and Laura (Field Marketing Manager). jobs.description: Our R&D team gathers ~100 engineers divided into ~15 product and technical squads. Each product squad includes developers, product managers and designers. They are paramount to 360Learning’s response to our increasingly demanding customers and are strategic players for the growth of the company. Today, we need someone to drive the Technical vision and coach the other developers in the Analytics Squad. We created the Tech Lead role to help developers with the technical aspects of their jobs, such as coding and planning, and coordinate the delivery timeline with Product Managers and Product Designers. jobs.description: About Agicap Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 600 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap fait partie du French Tech 120, qui récompense les startups les plus prometteuses de France. Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire. jobs.description: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI s operational blind spots into operational clarity. World s leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. The Role: We are looking for a curious, smart, and “learn it all” Architect with proven experience and a passion for designing transformative solution architectures for our prospects and customers. This high-impact role demands a unique blend of deep technical expertise and executive presence, requiring you to confidently present to C-level executives and translate their strategic goals into actionable technical plans. You will work with technical teams at our prospects and customers to design architectures that drive enterprise modernization , leveraging techniques like capability mapping and exploring innovative solutions with Agentic AI . Your primary goal is to support our growing sales team in achieving revenue goals by unlocking technical blockers and partnering closely with our Sales, Value Engineering, Product Management, Data Ops, and Information Security teams. You will be responsible for supporting engagements with new prospects as well as existing customers that look to expand their footprint. Measures of success include new customer acquisition rates, retention, up-selling, and contribution to overall sales team and business success. The work you’ll do: Lead and define the overall architecture, data, and cloud strategy

jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description: About Nous Nous is a household AI agent. It takes over the bills and admin people don't have time for and acts for them: switching energy, buying insurance, cancelling forgotten subscriptions, managing the family calendar. Nearly 250,000 UK households have signed up, and another joins every minute. We think the real value of AI isn't writing amazing cover letters, it's doing useful things in the real world for real people. That's the hard part, and a brilliant product is only half of it. An energy switch takes weeks, so our agents run on long-running workflows, not a single chat turn. Cancelling a subscription means a browser agent handling the code Apple sends to your phone. Buying insurance meant getting our regulatory principal comfortable with an agent doing it end to end (a UK first), which comes down to knowing exactly when the LLM should hand over to rules because a mistake would cost someone real money. We're about 30 people running one agent across energy, broadband, mobile, insurance, mortgages and subscriptions (with more being added), each with its own suppliers, rules and ways of going wrong. With far more problems than people, a person or small team owns each one end to end, from spotting it in the data or a customer conversation to shipping the fix. And because the agent acts, you find out quickly whether the fix worked. Everyone builds here: a product engineer launched our subscription cancellation product within a couple of months of joining, and a PM rebuilt our WhatsApp agent. And it's working. We're growing more than 20x year on year, with a market-leading NPS above +80, and we manage well over half a billion pounds of household spending. We've raised more than $30M from Heartcore, Mosaic and a who's who of entrepreneurs who founded Monzo, GoCardless, lastminute.com and Onfido. jobs.description: Über uns Die Weiler Consult GmbH ist eine Power-BI-Boutique für den deutschen Mittelstand und das Konzernumfeld. Rund 10 Power-BI-Expertinnen und -Experten bauen Reporting, das Geschäftsführer und CFOs wirklich nutzen. Unser Prinzip: Wir sind der Sherpa. Wir arbeiten remote-first, deutschlandweit, und treffen uns dreimal im Jahr zur Workation. Worum es geht Du bist die feste Ansprechperson für deine Kunden, vom Kickoff bis zur Verlängerung. Du machst sichtbar, was unsere Power-BI-Arbeit in den Zahlen des Kunden verändert, und steuerst die Umsetzung mit Entwicklern und Freelancern. In deiner Verantwortung liegen rund 10 bis 12 Kunden. Deine Aufgaben Du führst die Kundenbeziehungen, kennst Ziele und Kennzahlen deiner Kunden und hältst ihr Feedback in ClickUp fest. Du benennst die Veränderung in den Zahlen des Kunden, nicht die gelieferten Dashboards. Mit jedem Kunden führst du pro Quartal ein Strategie- und Roadmap-Gespräch: Zufriedenheit, Erfolge, Zielbild für zwei Jahre, Roadmap. Verlängerungen gehst du aktiv und rechtzeitig vor Vertragsende an. Aus der Roadmap entwickelst du Folgeprojekte. In der Umsetzung schneidest und priorisierst du Aufgaben in ClickUp, hältst Termine und koordinierst Entwickler und Freelancer. Du führst die Power-BI-Entwickler fachlich. Bei Unzufriedenheit, Budgetrisiko oder drohender Abwanderung eskalierst du früh. Das bringst du mit Du führst Kundengespräche selbstständig. Du verstehst betriebswirtschaftliche Zahlen und sprichst mit einem CFO auf Augenhöhe. Du kannst Power-BI-Berichte lesen und erklären. Du hältst Termine zuverlässig. Idealerweise hast du Grundlagen in DAX und Datenmodellierung oder Beratungserfahrung. Eher nichts für dich, wenn du Vertriebsgespräche meidest, lieber selbst entwickelst, über Dashboards statt Ergebnisse sprechen willst, Probleme aussitzt. Woran du gemessen wirst Verlängerungsquote (das Wichtigste), Folgeumsatz, Zufriedenheit und NPS, Quartalsgespräche, Termintreue, Budgettreue. Was wir bieten Zielgehalt 100.00

jobs.title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en Evaluation de la vulnérabilité d’un réseau d’accès Télécom de type PON (Passive Optical Network) vis-à-vis d’écoutes potentielles par DAS (Distributed Acoustic Sensor) - CDD de 12 mois
jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 5 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en évaluation de la vulnérabilité d’un réseau d’accès Télécom de type PON (Passive Optical Network) vis-à-vis d’écoutes potentielles par DAS (Distributed Acoustic Sensor) pour rejoindre le département Communications et Electronique (COMELEC). Cette étude se situe dans le cadre du projet « Ecoute Acoustique Terrestre » (EAT) RAPID (Régime d’Appui Pour l’Innovation Duale), fruit d’un partenariat entre la société Febus Optics et Télécom Paris. La mesure de vibrations acoustiques distribuées par fibre optique (DAS, Distributed Acoustic Sensing) est une technologie récente, dont les applications ne cessent de se diversifier. On peut citer par exemple la détection d’intrusion en surveillance périmétrique, les mesures sismiques, le diagnostic de puits (pétrole, géothermie), etc. La bande passante de la mesure, de sub-Hertz à la centaine de kiloHertz, permet également d’envisager la captation de la bande audio, et donc de réaliser des mesures audios sur une fibre optique. Il est ainsi possible d’utiliser le réseau optique télécom d’un bâtiment pour réaliser des écoutes, en utilisant un système DAS modifié, intégrant des artéfacts matériels particuliers (enroulement, antennes, connecteurs) au voisinage de la zone d’écoute et un traitement du signal spécifique pour obtenir des performances suffisantes. Le cadre de ce Postdoc est d’évaluer la vulnérabilité d’un réseau télécom vis-à-vis d’écoutes potentielles par DAS. Le branchement sur un réseau optique Telecom local en fonctionnement

Dans le cadre du projet « Réception de signaux GNSS sur antenne multicapteurs et réjection de brouilleurs » , qui vise à améliorer la robustesse des systèmes de réception GNSS (GPS, Galileo) face aux menaces de brouillage et de leurrage pour les besoins d'ArianeGroup, nous recrutons une post-doctorante ou un post-doctorant au sein de notre département Mathematical and Electrical Engineering (MEE) . Sous la responsabilité fonctionnelle de Thierry CHONAVEL et Abdeldjalil AISSA EL BEY et en collaboration avec l’équipe du projet et la société ARKANE, vous analyserez l’état de l’art des menaces de brouillage et de leurrage affectant les systèmes GNSS. Vous serez en charge de la modélisation et de la simulation de signaux GNSS et interférents réalistes en définissant des géométries de réseaux d’antennes adaptées. jobs.description: ABOUT QUINCE Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver. OUR CULTURE Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before. We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company s DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. Your mission is to turn those insights into action. You'll work directly with our Sales, Engineering, Marketing, and Implementation teams to understand customer needs, shape product positioning, strengthen our go-to-market strategy, and identify opportunities that drive revenue. jobs.description: Berlin · Full-time · Start ASAP About Limetax Limetax is building the agentic-first accounting and tax group for German SMEs. We acquire established accounting and tax advisory firms and onboard them to our proprietary agentic platform, combining deep industry expertise with AI-native technology. Backed by $40m in equity and debt from top-tier investors, we're building and scaling a new kind of accounting & tax group in Germany. Our founders bring significant experience across M&A, operations, and AI-native technology, having previously built and scaled unicorns, Razor Group and Augustus. You're part engineer, part product thinker, and fully hands-on. Your work will directly shape how our technology and agentic systems are deployed across the Limetax group. What You'll Work On Workflow Discovery. Work directly with tax professionals to understand complex operational workflows and identify where software and AI can have the biggest impact. Build software, internal tools, integrations, automations, and AI-enabled workflows that solve real problems across our firms. Production Deployment. Take solutions beyond prototypes and deploy them into live operational environments. Feedback & Iteration. Stay close to users after deployment, evaluate what works, and continuously improve

jobs.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Werk je graag zelfstandig en vind je het leuk om met de nieuwste technologieën te werken? Dan is de functie van Monteur Bouwplaatsbeveiliging bij RECO iets voor jou! Jouw baan als Monteur bij RECO Als Monteur Bouwplaatsbeveiliging ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het installeren en in bedrijf stellen van onze innovatieve beveiligingsoplossingen. Je werkt met slimme camerasystemen en hoogwaardige beveiligingsoplossingen. Denk aan snel inzetbare mobiele cameramasten, slimme detectiesystemen, mobiele brandmeldinstallaties, alarmsystemen en toegangscontrolesystemen. Zo draag jij elke dag bij aan veilige bouwplaatsen en projectlocaties. Je gaat zelfstandig op pad naar uiteenlopende projecten, waar je beveiligingsinstallaties monteert, configureert en gebruiksklaar oplevert. Daarnaast heb je nauw contact met onze werkvoorbereiders en planners die jouw werkzaamheden optimaal voor jou voorbereiden. Dankzij jouw technische kennis, improvisatievermogen en oog voor kwaliteit kunnen onze klanten rekenen op een betrouwbare beveiligingsoplossing die dag en nacht optimaal functioneert. Geen werkdag is hetzelfde. De ene dag installeer je een complee

jobs.description: Over NovoServe NovoServe levert hosted dedicated servers vanuit meerdere datacenters in Nederland. We zijn een snelgroeiend bedrijf met een informele sfeer en internationale ambities. We zetten fors in op automatisering, om snel te kunnen opschalen en onze klanten optimaal te kunnen bedienen. Om onze snelle groei mogelijk te maken, ontwikkelen we eigen systemen voor IaaS-dienstverlening. Wij beheren een internationaal netwerk dat meer dan 7.000 fysieke servers ondersteunt, 19 Tbps aan externe connectiviteit biedt en beschikt over tientallen peering-partners. Onze netwerkinfrastructuur is verspreid over 8 datacenters op twee continenten, wat zorgt voor een hoge beschikbaarheid, veerkracht en een wereldwijd bereik. Kern van de functie Als Procurement Specialist ben je verantwoordelijk voor het volledige inkoopproces voor onze servers en netwerkapparatuur: van de behoefte-inventarisatie tot en met het contractbeheer. Je werkt op internationaal niveau voor onze datacenters in Nederland, de Verenigde Staten en Denemarken. Je onderhoudt en versterkt duurzame relaties met onze belangrijkste leveranciers en blijft op de hoogte van nieuwe, opkomende spelers. Je neemt het voortouw in de leveranciersselectie en het contracteringsproces. Hierbij zorg je niet alleen voor de beste commerciële voorwaarden, maar waarborg je ook dat alle afspraken voldoen aan de actuele wet- en regelgeving en onze langetermijnstrategie. Naast inkoop ben je de drijvende kracht achter ons contractmanagement. Je beheert het contractregister waardoor we tijdig kunnen besluiten te verlengen of juist over te stappen naar een andere leverancier. Dit doe je niet alleen; je werkt nauw samen met interne stakeholders om ervoor te zorgen dat de inkoop perfect aansluit op de bedrijfsdoelstellingen. Samen met Portfolio management signaleer je markt- en prijsontwikkelingen en risico's, en neem je passende maatregelen. jobs.title: Tender Manager
jobs.description: Do you want to take ownership of how tenders are won, rather than simply contributing to them? Valcon is looking for an experienced Bid Manager to take the lead across the entire bid and tender process. From identifying and qualifying opportunities to defining the strategy, coordinating decision-making, managing stakeholders, safeguarding quality and evaluating results. The primary focus will be on European public tenders. This is explicitly not a traditional bid writing role. Rather than spending your days writing proposals yourself, you ensure that the right people deliver the strongest possible content at the right time. You create structure, challenge subject-matter experts, safeguard the strategy and quality, and keep stakeholders aligned throughout the process. But in case of emergency it is important for you to also be able to write a tender yourself, which occasionally will happen. The principle is simple: don’t write it yourself – enable the team to write it better. What will you do? As Bid Manager, you will be responsible for the end-to-end management of bids and tenders. You will oversee the full tender pipeline and take the lead on complex bid processes involving multiple disciplines, seniority levels and stakeholder interests. Your responsibilities include: Centrally identifying, qualifying and prioritising relevant tenders and commercial opportunities; Organising and facilitating Go/No-Go decisions and according to the required approval process; Developing and safeguarding the bid strategy; Translating it into a clear plan and structured tender process; Independently leading multidisciplinary bid teams consisting of partners, managers, consultants, subject matter experts and in some cases external stakeholders; Managing timelines, progress, compliance and quality throughout the entire bid process; Organising reviews and critically assessing contributions before submission; Safeguarding legal and procedural requirements, particularly for European public

jobs.title: CRM Specialist & E-mail Marketeer
jobs.description: CRM Specialist & E-mail Marketeer Een mail over sneakers verkoopt zichzelf bijna. Maar kun jij een inkoper in de metaalindustrie laten klikken op een actie voor wikkelfolie? Of een meubelmaker laten lachen om een nieuwsbrief over dozen? Bij Profipack verkopen we verpakkingsmaterialen aan bedrijven in zo'n 12 branches in Nederland, België, Duitsland en Oostenrijk. Geen fashion of skincare, wel dozen, tape en folie. En juist dat maakt het interessant. Ons e-mailkanaal staat nog in de kinderschoenen. Jij gaat het bouwen: van idee tot werkende flow. Wat ga je doen? Je bouwt e-mailflows en funnels per branche: welkom, herhaalaankoop, heractivatie en meer. Je zet input van de webshop en sales om in campagnes die opvallen, van creatief idee tot foutloos verzonden mail. Moet er een partij folie weg? Dan maak jij daar iets tofs van. Campagnes zoals Black Friday zet jij van begin tot eind neer. Je vertaalt succesvolle Nederlandse campagnes door naar onder andere Duitsland. Je rapporteert aan de e-commercemanager en werkt nauw samen met het designen webshopteam. Voor technisch complexere ideeën ben je het aanspreekpunt voor het externe bureau waarmee we werken. Heb je zelf een goed idee? Dan werk je dat gewoon uit. Wat breng je mee? 2 tot 4 jaar ervaring in e-mailmarketing, CRM of marketing automation, waarin je zelf flows technisch hebt opgezet in HubSpot (grote plus), Klaviyo of Salesforce Marketing Cloud. Je bent creatief én technisch onderlegd: je bedenkt de mail en zorgt zelf dat die goed live gaat. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands. Duits of Frans is mooi meegenomen. Ervaring in B2B en e-commerce is een pré, vooral B2B. Je hebt ervaring met Adobe of Canva, en je zet ChatGPT slim in. Je houdt van tempo, bent nieuwsgierig naar wat concurrenten doen en wordt blij van een kanaal dat nog niet "af" is. Waar kom je te werken? Op ons kantoor in De Meern, centraal in het land en op dezelfde plek als ons distributiecentrum. Je ziet dus letterlijk de dozen de deur uitgaan

Bij Adapteo krijg je in deze rol de kans waarbij ondernemerschap, duurzame groei en internationale ambities samenkomen. Vanuit Klundert bouw je aan nieuwe proposities en creëer je kansen binnen uiteenlopende sectoren. Een vacature voor een gedreven commerciële professional die graag pioniert en klantbehoeften achterhaalt. jobs.description: Wat ga je doen? Bij Cardiologie Centra Nederland, locatie Dokkum draai je zelfstandig spreekuur en ben je medisch inhoudelijk verantwoordelijk voor je eigen patiëntenpopulatie. Je stelt zelfstandig diagnose- en behandelplannen op, verricht risicostratificatie en begeleidt patiënten met uiteenlopende, complexe cardiologische beelden, zoals: Pijn op de borst (angina pectoris) en ischemische hartziekten; Hartritmestoornissen (o.a. atriumfibrilleren); Hartfalen, hypertensie en hypercholesterolemie; Hartkleplijden. Je combineert medisch-technische zorg met leefstijlgeneeskunde en langdurige opvolging. Waar nodig spar je op gelijkwaardige basis met de aanwezige cardiologen; de lijnen zijn bij ons kort en de sfeer is collegiaal. En omdat de inzet van een PA of VS bij onze locatie in Dokkum nieuw is, bieden we een kans: jij bouwt actief mee aan de vormgeving van deze rol en de polikliniek. Jouw visie, klinische blik en initiatief zijn hierin leidend. De locatie in Dokkum is gevestigd binnen het Sionsberg Netwerk Ziekenhuis. Je komt te werken in een toegankelijk en informeel team, waarin we echt voor elkaar klaarstaan. Bovendien biedt het werken in Dokkum rust en ruimte: gratis parkeren voor de deur, geen files en een prachtige omgeving. Bij CCN denken we mee over jouw ontwikkeling. Mocht jij jouw werk bijvoorbeeld op de cardiologie willen afwisselen met ervaring binnen bijvoorbeeld de traumatologie. Dan is dit zeker bespreekbaar na de opstart van deze nieuwe rol binnen onze poli cardiologie. Over ons: onze zorg klopt! We zijn een organisatie van zelfstandige behandelcentra voor hart- en vaatziekten die zich onderscheidt door poliklinische zorg perfect af te stemmen op de behoeften van de patiënt en de verwijzer. We geloven in de kracht van complete zorg onder één dak. Onze patiënten kunnen dicht bij huis terecht voor de meest hoogwaardige cardiologische zorg, en jij speelt daarin een belangrijke rol. jobs.title: Afstudeeropdracht HBO – Digitale Bouwplaats & AI
jobs.description: Job Description RECO is actief in de verhuur en dienstverlening rondom de bouwplaats, onder andere op het gebied van tijdelijke huisvesting, energie, verlichting, steigerbouw, verticaal transport en bouwplaatsbeveiliging. De bouwplaats wordt steeds digitaler. Data, IoT, AI, SaaS-oplossingen, sensoren en realtime monitoring bieden mogelijkheden om niet alleen afzonderlijke producten digitaal te ondersteunen, maar de bouwplaats als geheel slimmer, veiliger en efficiënter te maken. Wat ga je doen? Hoe kan RECO een schaalbaar digitaal platform/concept ontwikkelen waarmee bouwplaatsen integraal digitaal kunnen worden gemonitord, aangestuurd en geoptimaliseerd, waarbij SaaS, AI, IoT en bestaande RECO-diensten samenkomen? Daarbij staat niet één afzonderlijk product centraal, maar de vraag: Hoe ziet de bouwplaats van de toekomst eruit en welke digitale rol kan RECO daarin vervullen? Het doel is om een conceptueel uitgewerkt en onderbouwd digitaliseringsconcept op te leveren dat RECO kan gebruiken als basis voor verdere ontwikkeling en eventuele realisatie. De opdracht moet nadrukkelijk voorkomen dat er alleen een theoretisch adviesrapport ontstaat. Je wordt uitgedaagd om hands-on met technologie te werken en waar mogelijk een werkend prototype of proof-of-concept te ontwikkelen. Requirements Wat breng jij mee? 👍 HBO opleding in Software Development of Engineering, ICT, Technische Informatica, Business IT & Management, AI & Data Science of Applied Data Science 👍 Analytisch sterk met een ondernemende instelling; 👍 Interesse in AI, SaaS en cloud 👍 Affiniteit met softwareontwikkeling; 👍 Kunnen vertalen van klantproblemen naar digitale oplossingen; 👍 Zelfstandig onderzoek kunnen uitvoeren; 👍 Bereidheid om een prototype daadwerkelijk te bouwen. 👍 Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal. Bij RECO willen we jou blij maken met: ✅ Een goede stagevergoeding. ✅ Begeleiding door ervaren professionals, dicht bij de business. ✅ Ruimte voor eigen initiatief en onderzoek. ✅ Werken

jobs.title: Liftmonteur Werkplaats
jobs.description: Job Description Sleutel jij graag aan techniek die blijft bewegen? Als Liftmonteur in onze werkplaats zorg jij ervoor dat bouwliften in topconditie blijven. Met jouw technische kennis los je storingen op en maak je iedere lift klaar voor gebruik. Jouw baan als Liftmonteur op de werkplaats bij RECO Als Liftmonteur op de werkplaats van de afdeling Verticaal Transport bij RECO zorg jij dat onze bouwliften altijd veilig draaien en klaarstaan voor de volgende klus. Jij sleutelt aan personen- en goederenliften, loopt ze volledig na en zorgt dat storingen snel opgelost worden. Of het nou mechanisch of elektrisch is: jij zoekt het probleem op en vindt de passende oplossing. Ook bij grotere of ingewikkelde storingen draai jij je hand niet om voor een goede oplossing. Jouw belangrijkste werkzaamheden bestaan uit: ✅ Onderhouden, inspecteren en gereedmaken van bouwliften in onze werkplaats. ✅ Opsporen en verhelpen van mechanische en elektrische storingen. ✅ Zelfstandig complexe storingen uitlezen, analyseren en verhelpen; ✅ Werken vanuit de werkplaats en waar nodig afstemmen met collega-monteurs om samen tot de beste oplossing te komen. Requirements Wat breng jij mee? 👍 Je bent 32 - 40 uur per week beschikbaar van 7-16 uur;👍 Werkervaring hebt op het gebied van mechatronisch en bij voorkeur ook elektrotechniek; 👍 Je hebt een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal; 👍 Je hebt bij voorkeur een rijbewijs B en eigen vervoer in bezit; 👍 Je bent in het bezit van je VCA-certificaat óf wil deze via ons behalen; 👍 Je bent een echte doener, neemt initiatief, probleemoplossend vermogen én kunt goed samenwerken. jobs.title: Grondwerker Bouwplaatsinrichting
jobs.description: Job Description Jij steekt graag je handen uit de mouwen en zorgt dat alles onder de grond én op de bouwplaats goed geregeld is — samen maken we het werk klaar. Jouw baan als Grondwerker bij RECO Als Grondwerker Bouwplaatsinrichting bij RECO werk je elke dag buiten op verschillende bouwplaatsen in Nederland. Samen met collega’s zorg je ervoor dat alles wat nodig is op en rond de bouwplaats goed wordt voorbereid en aangelegd. Je doet graafwerk, legt voorzieningen aan en helpt mee bij technische werkzaamheden. Je werkt vaak samen in een duo en bent bezig met praktisch werk waar je aan het einde van de dag duidelijk resultaat van ziet. Geen dag is hetzelfde: de ene keer sta je op een nieuw project, de andere keer werk je verder waar je gisteren bent begonnen. jobs.title: Sales Manager
jobs.description: Win new restaurants across Germany and help build one of our fastest-growing markets from the ground up. Full-time About SOUS SOUS exists to give independent restaurants the same acquisition-to-retention infrastructure that only chains and delivery platforms could previously afford. We build it as one connected data layer, replacing the fragmented stack most restaurants run today: a listings tool here, a separate storefront there, and no CRM at all. Spotlight owns discovery, as search shifts from Google links to AI assistants recommending where to eat. Commerce owns the transaction and, critically, the guest relationship that marketplaces have been extracting for a decade. Every order through that owned channel generates data that sharpens the next cycle of visibility, personalisation and retention, compounding in the restaurant's favour instead of the platform's. Our long-term bet is simple. As AI becomes the default interface for "where should I eat", the restaurants that own their guest data and their presence in that layer will keep the margin, and the ones still renting both from marketplaces will not. We are building the infrastructure to make the first outcome the default, not the exception. We are a team of 27, working from our headquarters on the Vijzelstraat in Amsterdam city centre, and we are growing fast across the Netherlands, Germany and South Africa. About the role SOUS helps independent food and beverage entrepreneurs grow by building what we believe will be the last employee a restaurant owner ever has to hire that touches a screen. After a strong start in the Netherlands, Germany is now one of our most important growth markets, and we are scaling our team there quickly. As Sales Manager Germany you bring SOUS to independent restaurants across the country. jobs.description: Bouw mee aan hoogwaardige hoorzorg binnen een zelfstandige optiekwinkel Ben jij audicien en wil je méér dan alleen hoortoestellen aanpassen? Zoek je een plek waar je de tijd krijgt voor je klant, kwaliteit vooropstaat en je tegelijkertijd de ruimte krijgt om mee te bouwen aan een succesvolle audiotak? Dan is dit misschien wel jouw volgende stap. Premium hoorzorg, zoals het bedoeld is Binnen onze zelfstandige optiekwinkels staat persoonlijke aandacht centraal. Onze klanten kennen ons vanwege onze deskundigheid, kwaliteit en service. Diezelfde benadering willen we verder uitbouwen binnen horen. Daarom zoeken we een audicien die samen met ons wil bouwen aan een sterke audiotak. Afhankelijk van de situatie gaat het om het verder ontwikkelen van een bestaande klantenkring of het opbouwen van een nieuwe activiteit binnen een winkel waar al een vertrouwde klantenbasis aanwezig is. Je krijgt daarbij de ruimte om je vak uit te oefenen zoals jij vindt dat goede hoorzorg hoort te zijn: met tijd voor de klant, persoonlijke aandacht en premium hooroplossingen. Wat maakt deze functie anders? Je werkt in een professionele, persoonlijke omgeving waar niet de snelle verkoop, maar de beste oplossing voor de klant centraal staat. Je kunt rekenen op: · Premium hooroplossingen · Ruim voldoende tijd en aandacht voor iedere klant · Een bestaand klantenbestand vanuit de optiek · Warme leads via onze partner Audibene · Professionele ondersteuning en coaching vanuit de organisatie · Ruimte voor jouw ideeën en vakmanschap · De kans om daadwerkelijk mee te bouwen aan de audiotak · Dagen en uren in overleg, met aandacht voor een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé Voor wie is dit een mooie stap? Misschien werk je nu bij een grotere keten en zoek je meer persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en betrokkenheid. Of je bent toe aan een omgeving waarin je niet alleen audicien bent, maar ook kunt meedenken over hoe we de beste hoorzorg voor onze klanten organiseren. Ruime ervaring is voor ons niet het belan

jobs.title: Publishing Product Director
jobs.description: As Publishing Product Director , you are the creative custodian of one of Crytek’s games, embedded inside the game team, accountable for protecting the creative vision and translating the promise of the game into work that the publishing team can execute with conviction. The success of a great game depends on the work that surrounds it landing as truthfully as the game itself, and closing that gap is what this role exists to do. You make sure that what reaches players is authentic, aspirational, tells the story the game deserves, and delights the players who play it. The game in your remit is an unannounced project in the Crytek portfolio. The work focuses on shaping the project’s player promise from the inside out, defining the publishing narrative for its eventual reveal, and carrying its creative vision through to launch and into ongoing releases. You sit inside the game team, working shoulder-to-shoulder with game leadership every day. You partner directly with the Chief Publishing Officer and Brand & Marketing Director to support both the game and the business as one connected effort. You are the direct line between the game team and the publishing organization, the person who protects the north star on both ends, and the person both sides trust to tell them the truth. This role demands creative conviction, drive, and the kind of experience that only comes from working shoulder-to-shoulder with game teams. You will protect the team from noise so they can build the game, and you will give the publishing team the clarity, player insight, and creative truth they need to land it well. It is one of the most consequential seats at Crytek, and one of the most rewarding. jobs.title: Business Continuity Management Lead
jobs.description: About the Role Mercury is seeking a Business Continuity Management (BCM) Lead to build and lead an enterprise-wide continuity program as we prepare to become a bank. As part of the Risk team, this leader will establish practical standards, clear accountability, and tested capabilities to maintain critical services and recover effectively from disruptions, with direct visibility to the CRO and senior leadership. This role fills the need for a dedicated leader to coordinate BCM across the organization. The ideal candidate combines deep continuity and resilience expertise with the judgment to build a proportionate program in a fast-moving environment, working effectively with Engineering, Operations, Product, Information Security, Legal, Compliance, and business teams. The BCM Lead will own the enterprise framework, coordination, oversight, and reporting. Business and technology owners will remain accountable for their continuity plans and recovery execution.Because this is a new program, the Lead will be hands-on in the initial build: facilitating the first round of BIAs and plans side by side with owners, running exercises, and driving identified gaps through remediation. This leader will also work closely with Engineering on technology disaster recovery and with relevant teams on incident response, crisis management, and third-party resilience. jobs.description: LA MAISON JACQUEMUS Jacquemus was founded by Simon Porte Jacquemus in 2009 in Paris, France. Dedicated to the memory of the designer’s late mother, the brand draws inspiration from a passion for culture. The Jacquemus ready-to-wear and accessories collections for men and women reference the French way of life and universal gestures of beauty, encompassing influences from fine art photography to decorative arts, cinema, painting, and sculpture. Throughout the years, Jacquemus has staged runway productions in unique and unexpected locations, including a Parisian swimming pool, the Musée Picasso, a lavender field in Provence, a wheat field outside Paris, a salt marsh in the Camargue, and a beach in Hawaii. More recently, the brand has embraced settings such as the canal of the Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), the Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), Casa Malaparte (La Casa) and Auguste Perret’s Parisian apartment (La Croisière). Based in the 8th arrondissement of Paris, Jacquemus is an independent fashion house with over 300 employees. Renowned for its fast-growing digital presence and its worldwide business spread, the brand has created innovative retail experiences around the world before opening its first permanent flagship store at 58 Avenue Montaigne in Paris in 2022. Following this milestone, international boutiques have opened in New York (SoHo), London (New Bond Street), Los Angeles (Melrose Avenue) and Dubai. You will strive to discover your clients' personalities and identify their desires while introducing them to the DNA of the House and its entire product range. jobs.description: At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success. Kpler is expanding into high-value maritime verticals, with Cruise Liners and Port Operations representing two important opportunities. Both address a common market need: the lack of independent, reliable insights into actual performance, built on observed data rather than published schedules or self-reported information. In the cruise sector, operators and analysts often rely on published itineraries rather than actual vessel movements, despite the significant fuel and carbon costs associated with fleet operations. In ports, performance data is often incomplete or self-reported, creating a need for independent benchmarking as berth-level emissions carry increasing financial implications under schemes such as the EU ETS. As a Senior Product Manager, Cruise Liners & Port Operations, you will own both products end to end, from strategy and roadmap through to the first release and go-to-market. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, you will build two early-stage products in parallel, leveraging Kpler’s network of more than 13,000 AIS receivers and over 10,000 mapped ports and berths. jobs.description: SwissBorg is building the future of crypto wealth management, making investing more accessible, transparent and intuitive for everyone. At the core of our platform is the Meta-Exchange (MEX). This smart routing engine connects multiple exchanges and liquidity sources to deliver optimal execution in a single, seamless app. We're Swiss-engineered, regulated, and trusted by nearly one million users managing over $1B in crypto assets. But beyond the numbers, what drives us is the people behind every wallet and a commitment to continuously improving how they experience and interact with crypto. Join us! Are you an Accountant with a strong technical foundation, ideally shaped in a Big 4 audit or accounting outsourcing team, looking for broad, hands-on responsibility in an international group? SwissBorg is a crypto wealth management platform operating through a group of regulated entities across Switzerland, France, Estonia and other jurisdictions. Our accounting team is small, and every member makes a real difference. In this role, you will own Accounts Payable and contribute across the full scope of the accounting function: month-end close, reconciliations, intercompany, VAT and tax, and audit preparation. We would love to hear from you if you are a versatile all-rounder who enjoys the variety that comes with a multi-entity group. The ideal candidate can step into any part of the accounting cycle, from processing supplier invoices to preparing audit files. You will: Own the Accounts Payable process: supplier invoice review and coding (ApprovalMax/Xero), payment preparation, supplier statement reconciliations and vendor master data Prepare and manage general ledger entries, accruals and prepayments Monthly, quarterly and annual closes for all group entities, in collaboration with external accounting firms Balance sheet and bank reconciliations, and account analysis to ensure balances are correct and supported Monthly intercompany reconciliations, recharges and settlements

jobs.title: Engineering Manager Embedded
jobs.description: Our mission at Qwello is to revolutionize the charging industry, we are committed to turn the world from combustion to electric. We put the customer first. We know their needs and deliver results they love. We design, build and operate charging infrastructure for the public space. We excel in simplicity, user focus and engineering excellence. We value diversity of thought, background and approaches and foster a culture of belonging. We understand that the best products are built by excellent teams, not individual superstars. Be part of shaping the E-mobility of the future! We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Embedded team - the team that designs, builds and ships Qwello's AC charging stations, from circuit board to firmware to the production line. This is not a pure software management role. Your team of 6-8 spans embedded software, electrical engineering and mechanical engineering, and your scope runs from the firmware release train for thousands of chargers in the field, through EMC labs and Eichrecht certification audits, to the contract manufacturer's factory floor. Our firmware is built on embedded Linux (Yocto) and EVerest, the open source EV charging stack we actively contribute to upstream. We are working with Rust, Python, C & C++. You will not be the deepest specialist in any one of these - your tech leads are - but you must be technical enough to represent the team when they are not in the room, to challenge estimates, and to make trade-offs between firmware, hardware and regulatory constraints with confidence and competence. If you have led embedded or hardware-adjacent teams, enjoy being the person to which a factory, a certification body and a firmware engineer all escalate in the same week, and who brings the self-organization to keep all of it moving without dropping balls, we would love to talk. We are transforming event ticketing for global leaders like the Grammys, the Golden Globes, Stanford University and the Hockenheimring turning what was once a simple transaction into a strategic business advantage. jobs.title: Automotive MCU Chip Architect
jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced Automotive MCU Chip Architect to define the system and subsystem architecture of next-generation automotive microcontrollers. The role includes ownership of chip-level architecture concepts, subsystem partitioning, compute and memory architecture, interconnect strategy, safety and security integration, power/reset/clock concepts, and hardware/software interface definition. The successful candidate will work closely with product management, safety, security, design, verification, software, and implementation teams to ensure the MCU architecture meets demanding automotive requirements for real-time performance, functional safety, cybersecurity, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency. What you'll do Key Responsibilities System Architecture Definition Define the overall automotive MCU architecture from product, customer, and market requirements. Translate use cases into chip-level requirements covering performance, safety, security, power, cost, and scalability. Drive system partitioning across CPUs, memories, interconnects, peripherals, safety/security functions, debug, test, and power domains. Own architecture trade-offs and document decision rationale for reuse across MCU families and derivatives. Subsystem Architecture Ownership Align subsystem concepts and interfaces across compute, memory, bus/interconnect, peripheral, safety, security, power/reset/clock, debug/trace, and DFT/test domains. Ensure subsystem requirements are implementation-feasible and verifiable at RTL, subsystem, chip, silicon, and software levels. Define hardware/software-visible architecture elements such as memory maps, register model principles, interrupts, DMA, boot flow, and access-control concepts. jobs.description: Who We Are: We are a rapidly growing embodied AI company revolutionizing human labor. Leveraging cutting-edge robotics and advanced artificial intelligence, we develop transformative technologies that redefine how work is done across multiple industries—empowering businesses to streamline operations, boost productivity, and unlock new possibilities. Overview: We are looking for a world-class robotics professionals to join our R&D hub in the Zurich area . In this role, you will be at the forefront of developing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models that enable robots to understand and interact with the world with unprecedented generalization. You will work on the intersection of large-scale foundation models and real-world robotic execution, bridging the gap between state-of-the-art research and deployed embodied intelligence. Your Responsibilities: Research & Development: Design, implement, and scale VLA models and foundation architectures for robotic manipulation and navigation. Scaling Laws & Data: Develop strategies for multi-modal data collection, synthetic data generation, and efficient fine-tuning of large-scale models. Algorithm Optimization: Optimize model inference for real-time robotic applications without compromising reasoning capabilities. Publication & Visibility: Contribute to the global research community by publishing high-impact papers at top-tier conferences (NeurIPS, CVPR, ICRA, CoRL, etc.). Collaboration: Work closely with the Core Robotics and Hardware teams to integrate AI models into our physical platforms. jobs.title: Structures Analyst
jobs.description: We are looking for a Structural Analysis Engineer to size and verify our rocket structures, from load cases and finite-element analysis through to margins of safety and hardware release. You will provide the analysis that design, manufacturing, and test teams rely on to move quickly and confidently. Working across composite and metallic structures, you will turn each design iteration into a result that can be built, tested, and ultimately trusted in flight. About us We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications. We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, have just crossed €10m in revenue for our first operating year and are applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket. We are working hard to build something truly spectacular. To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you. At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you. Key responsibilities Define load cases, boundary conditions, and acceptance criteria for primary and secondary rocket structures. Build, run, and document analytical and FEA models of composite and metallic components. Evaluate margins of safety and failure modes, preparing analyses for design reviews and hardware release. Drive lay-up and geometry iterations with the design and manufacturing teams. Correlate analysis results with structural-test data and feed findings

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent
